import sys,json,csv,io,base64,struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from campaign import audit
from common import parse_json
HDR=('type','id','revision','published','op','lease','event','probe','target','responder','result','service','attempt','payload')
def cap(rows):
 s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(HDR)
 for r in rows:w.writerow(r)
 return {'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(s.getvalue().encode()).decode()]}
def app(rid,rev,pub,event,target,result,attempt='0',payload='',service='a'):
 return ['app',rid,str(rev),str(pub),'put','h',str(event),'',target,'',result,service,attempt,payload]
def icmp(rid,rev,pub,event,probe,target,resp,result):
 return ['icmp',rid,str(rev),str(pub),'put','h',str(event),probe,target,resp,result,'','','']
# semantic collapse same app identity at rev2: same decoded payload bytes (AB== vs AA==)
rows=[app('x',2,10,'001','2001:DB8::1','open',attempt='000',payload='AB=='),
      app('x',2,10,'1','2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001','open',attempt='0',payload='AA==')]
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],
 'services':[{'id':'a','kind':'adb'}],'queries':[10],'captures':[cap(rows)],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()))
print('collapse ledger',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],'rej',out['rejected'])
assert out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']=={'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}
# conflict at higher rev, lower unique cannot repair
rows=[app('y',1,10,'1','2001:db8::1','closed'),
      app('y',2,10,'1','2001:db8::1','closed'),
      app('y',2,10,'1','2001:db8::2','closed')]
job['captures']=[cap(rows)];job['queries']=[10]
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()))
print('conflict ledger',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],'rej',out['rejected'])
assert out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']=={'live':0,'deleted':0,'conflict':1}
# publication visibility: rev2 conflict published20, at q10 lower rev1 unique live
rows=[app('y',1,10,'1','2001:db8::1','closed'),
      app('y',2,20,'1','2001:db8::1','closed'),
      app('y',2,20,'1','2001:db8::2','closed')]
job['captures']=[cap(rows)];job['queries']=[10,20]
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()))
print('visibility ledgers',[s['ledger'] for s in out['snapshots']])
assert [s['ledger'] for s in out['snapshots']]==[{'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0},{'live':0,'deleted':0,'conflict':1}]
# delete / put resurrection
rows=[['app','z','0','1','delete','','','','','','','','',''],app('z',1,5,'1','2001:db8::1','closed')]
job['captures']=[cap(rows)];job['queries']=[1,5]
out=audit(parse_json(json.dumps(job).encode()))
print('resurrect',[s['ledger'] for s in out['snapshots']])
assert [s['ledger'] for s in out['snapshots']]==[{'live':0,'deleted':1,'conflict':0},{'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}]
print('semantic tests OK')
EOF
